<!-- Generated by cargo xtask docs. Do not edit. -->

You can use this page to look up each field of a `rdy/v1` spec. Each table shows the type, whether the field is required, its default, what the field does and an example. Each example is a valid value for its field. A field that takes an object in one of its forms has a section below for that form.

A vendor's readiness requirements (`apiVersion: rdy/v1`, `kind: Readiness`).

Check ids this schema does not know are allowed and reported as not run. Every other unknown key is an error, so a newer spec fails loudly on an older rdy.

## Top-level fields

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiVersion` | one of `rdy/v1` | yes |  | Format version. Must be `rdy/v1`. Kept as text so the message for a wrong version can quote what the file said. |  |
| `kind` | one of `Readiness` | yes |  | Document kind. Only `Readiness` exists in v1. |  |
| `metadata` | object | yes |  | Who the spec is for and how fresh it is. |  |
| `checks` | array of object | yes |  | The checks to run, in report order. Entries are keyed by id plus optional name, and keys must be unique. A valid spec has 1 to 256 entries. |  |
| `bundle` | object | no |  | What `rdy bundle` collects. It parses today so specs written now keep working, and `rdy run` never collects anything. |  |

## metadata

The `metadata` block: who the spec is for, which revision it is and when it stops being valid.

Unknown keys are refused.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `product` | string | yes |  | Product name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Ties the signature to a trusted key and names the report directory and files. |  |
| `version` | string | no |  | Product versions this spec is for, such as `>=4.2`, at most 64 characters. Shown in the report and never evaluated, because rdy cannot know the product version. |  |
| `contact` | string | no |  | Where the customer asks questions, at most 256 characters. Shown as plain text, never as a link. |  |
| `serial` | integer | no |  | Spec revision number, 0 to 9007199254740991. Should go up by at least one on every signed release of this spec. Shown as "Spec revision 7". |  |
| `expires` | string | no |  | The UTC time after which rdy refuses to run this spec, in the full form `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, for example `2027-01-31T00:00:00Z`. Kept as text here. The shape and the comparison with the clock are checked when the spec is validated. |  |
| `annotations` | object | no |  | Up to 32 free-form labels for vendor tooling and the portal. rdy never changes behaviour because of them and copies them into the result. Keys are lowercase, 1 to 63 characters, and values are at most 256 characters. |  |

## checks entries

One check to run: an id, the common fields below, and the parameters of that check id. Parameters of ids this schema does not know are not checked here.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  | Which check to run: family.name in lowercase, for example host.memory. |  |
| `name` | string | no |  | Short label, shown next to the id. Needed when the same id appears twice. |  |
| `severity` | one of `block`, `warn` | no | `block` | block (the default) makes a failure NOT READY. warn makes it READY with warnings. |  |
| `fix` | string | no |  | What the customer should do when this check fails. Plain text. Shown instead of rdy's own advice, which stays available below it. |  |
| `timeout` | string | no |  | How long this check may run, 1s to 60s. Replaces the check's own default. Outside that range the check is not run and lint reports an error. |  |
| `os` | array of one of `linux`, `macos`, `windows` | no |  | Run only on these operating systems. On others the check is reported as not applicable and does not count. |  |

### host.cpu

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | integer | no |  | Fewer cores than this: the check fails. Container limits count. | `4` |
| `recommended` | integer | no |  | Fewer cores than this: the check warns. | `8` |
| `arch` | array of one of `x86_64`, `aarch64`, `amd64`, `arm64` | no |  | The host must have one of these architectures. `amd64` is `x86_64` and `arm64` is `aarch64`. |  |
| `flags` | array of string | no |  | CPU flags the host must have, such as `avx2` or `x86-64-v3`. At most 64. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.cpu
min: 4
recommended: 8
```

### host.memory

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | integer or string | yes |  | Less total RAM than this: the check fails, after the tolerance. | `16Gi` |
| `min_available` | integer or string | no |  | Less available RAM than this: the check warns. The default, half of `min`, is the check's. |  |
| `swap` | one of `forbid`, `any` | no | `any` | What to do when swap is on. The default is `any`. |  |
| `tolerance_percent` | number | no |  | How far below `min` the total may be and still pass, in percent. A 32 GiB machine shows a little less. The default is 5. The check applies it with a floor of 256 MiB. 0 turns it off. |  |
| `tolerance_result` | one of `pass`, `warn` | no | `pass` | What a total inside the tolerance counts as. The default is `pass`. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.memory
min: 16Gi
```

### host.disk

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | The install path. When it does not exist yet, the nearest existing parent is measured. | `/var/lib/acme` |
| `min` | integer or string | yes |  | Less free space than this: the check fails. | `50Gi` |
| `recommended` | integer or string | no |  | Less free space than this: the check warns. The default, `min` plus 20%, is the check's. | `60Gi` |
| `min_inodes` | integer | no |  | Fewer free inodes than this: the check fails. |  |
| `forbid_options` | array of one of `noexec`, `nosuid`, `nodev`, `ro` | no |  | Mount options that make the check fail. |  |
| `forbid_fstypes` | array of string | no |  | Filesystem types that make the check fail, such as `nfs`. At most 32. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.disk
path: /var/lib/acme
min: 50Gi
recommended: 60Gi
```

### host.ports

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `free` | array of integer or object | no |  | TCP ports that must be free. At most 256. | `[80, 443, 6443, 10250]` |
| `udp_free` | array of integer | no |  | UDP ports that must be free. At most 256, none twice. |  |
| `allow_owner` | array of string | no |  | Process names that may already hold a port, such as an earlier install of the product. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.ports
free:
- 80
- 443
- 6443
- 10250
```

#### free entries, as an object

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `port` | integer | yes |  | 1 to 65535. |  |
| `bind` | one of `public`, `loopback` | no | `public` | How the product binds it. `public` is the default and means every address. `loopback` means loopback only. |  |

### host.lsm

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selinux` | object | no |  | What to expect of SELinux. | `{"allow": ["enforcing"], "denials_max": 0}` |
| `apparmor` | object | no |  | What to expect of AppArmor. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.lsm
selinux:
  allow:
  - enforcing
  denials_max: 0
```

#### selinux

What to expect of SELinux.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allow` | array of one of `enforcing`, `permissive`, `disabled` | no |  | The modes that are fine. Any other mode makes the check fail. Without it every mode is fine. |  |
| `denials_max` | integer | no |  | More recent denials than this: the check warns. It fails when the context is in `watch`. |  |
| `denials_window` | string | no |  | How far back denials count, such as `24h`. |  |
| `watch` | array of string | no |  | Security contexts or programs whose denials make the check fail. |  |

#### apparmor

What to expect of AppArmor.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allow` | array of one of `enabled`, `disabled` | no |  | The states that are fine. Any other state makes the check fail. |  |
| `require_profiles` | array of string | no |  | Profiles that must be loaded. |  |

### host.security_agents

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `forbid` | array of string | no |  | Agent ids that make the check fail when detected. `rdy spec lint` lists the known ids. | `["example-agent"]` |
| `allow` | array of string | no |  | Agent ids that are fine when detected. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.security_agents
forbid:
- example-agent
```

### host.os

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `supported` | array of object | no |  | The distributions the product supports. At most 64. | `[{"id": "ubuntu", "versions": ["22.04"]}]` |
| `arch` | array of one of `x86_64`, `aarch64`, `amd64`, `arm64` | no |  | The host must have one of these architectures. |  |
| `fips` | one of `forbid`, `require`, `any` | no | `any` | What to expect of FIPS mode. The default is `any`. | `any` |
| `windows_min_build` | integer | no |  | The lowest Windows build number that is supported. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.os
supported:
- id: ubuntu
  versions:
  - "22.04"
fips: any
```

#### supported entries

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  | The distribution id from `/etc/os-release`, such as `rhel`. |  |
| `versions` | array of string | no |  | The versions that are supported. `"8"` matches a major version and `"22.04"` an exact one. Without it every version is. |  |

### host.firewall

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open_inbound` | array of integer | no |  | TCP ports that must be open for inbound traffic, 1 to 256, none twice. | `[6443, 10250]` |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.firewall
open_inbound:
- 6443
- 10250
```

### host.time_sync

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_skew` | string | no |  | The offset from the time servers above which the check blocks. The default is 300s, because AWS signing, Kerberos and TLS validity fail near five minutes. The warning level is `recommended_skew`. | `300s` |
| `recommended_skew` | string | no |  | The offset above which the check warns. The default is 5s. Set `max_skew` as well to move the block level. When both are set, this must not be greater than `max_skew`. | `5s` |
| `require_sync` | boolean | no | `false` | A clock that is not synchronized blocks. The default is false. | `true` |
| `ntp_servers` | array of string | no |  | Servers to measure the offset against, 1 to 8, none twice. There are no default servers: without this list the offset is not measured and rdy sends no time packet. | `["ntp.acme.test"]` |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.time_sync
recommended_skew: 5s
max_skew: 300s
require_sync: true
ntp_servers:
- ntp.acme.test
```

### host.sysctl

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expect` | object | no |  | Kernel parameters and what each must be, 1 to 64. A live value that differs blocks. A right value that no file in a sysctl.d directory sets warns. The same parameter written twice, as vm.max_map_count and vm/max_map_count, is refused. | `{"vm.max_map_count": ">=262144", "net.ipv4.ip_forward": 1}` |
| `limits` | object | no |  | File limits and what each must be. | `{"nofile": ">=65536"}` |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.sysctl
expect:
  vm.max_map_count: ">=262144"
  net.ipv4.ip_forward: 1
limits:
  nofile: ">=65536"
```

#### limits

File limits and what each must be.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nofile` | integer or string | no |  | The open files limit that services get, DefaultLimitNOFILE of systemd. |  |

### host.container_runtime

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runtime` | array of one of `docker`, `containerd`, `podman`, `crio` | no |  | Runtimes of which one must be present, 1 to 4. | `["docker", "containerd"]` |
| `min_version` | string or integer | no |  | An older runtime blocks. Needs `runtime` with exactly one entry, because one number means nothing across several runtimes. |  |
| `cgroup_driver` | one of `systemd`, `cgroupfs` | no |  | The cgroup driver the runtime must use. A runtime that differs from the kubelet blocks too. | `systemd` |
| `storage_driver` | string | no |  | The storage driver the runtime must use, such as `overlay2`. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.container_runtime
runtime:
- docker
- containerd
cgroup_driver: systemd
```

### host.cgroups

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | one of `v2`, `v1`, `any` | no | `any` | The cgroup version the host must have. The default is `any`. | `v2` |
| `controllers` | array of string | no |  | Controllers that must be available, such as `cpu`, `memory`, `io` and `pids`. 1 to 32, none twice. | `["cpu", "memory", "io", "pids"]` |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.cgroups
version: v2

- cpu

- pids
```

### host.kernel

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | string or integer | no |  | An older kernel blocks. | `"5.4"` |
| `distro_min` | object | no |  | A minimum for one distribution, by its os-release id, 1 to 16. It replaces `min` on that distribution, because a vendor kernel carries fixes under an older number. | `{"rhel": "4.18.0-305"}` |
| `modules` | array of string | no |  | Modules that must be available, 1 to 64, none twice. One that is absent blocks and one that is not loaded warns. | `["overlay", "br_netfilter"]` |
| `btf` | boolean | no | `false` | The kernel must expose BTF type information. The default is false. Only true counts as a threshold. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: host.kernel
min: "5.4"
distro_min:
  rhel: 4.18.0-305
modules:
- overlay
- br_netfilter
```

### net.egress

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoints` | array of string or object | yes |  | The endpoints, 1 to 64. | `["https://registry.acme.test/"]` |
| `via_proxy` | one of `auto`, `direct`, `proxy_only` | no | `auto` | Which path to try. The default is `auto`. `auto` tries what the product would do, and says if the other path works. `direct` uses no proxy. `proxy_only` goes only through the proxy. |  |
| `trust` | one of `system`, `bundled` | no | `system` | Which certificates to trust. The default is `system`. `system` is the operating system's store, with the bundled public roots as a fallback. `bundled` is the bundled public roots only. |  |
| `max_latency` | string | no |  | A connect slower than this: the check warns. The default, 2s, is the check's. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: net.egress
endpoints:
- https://registry.acme.test/
```

#### endpoints entries, as an object

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | string | yes |  | Where to connect. |  |
| `optional` | boolean | no | `false` | Unreachable gives a warning and not a block. The default is false. |  |
| `expect_status` | array of integer | no |  | The statuses that count as reachable, for a URL target. At most 16. |  |
| `method` | one of `HEAD`, `GET` | no | `HEAD` | The request method, for a URL target. The default is `HEAD`. |  |
| `via_proxy` | one of `auto`, `direct`, `proxy_only` | no |  | Overrides the `via_proxy` of the entry for this endpoint. |  |
| `tls` | boolean | no |  | `false` probes plain TCP only. Without it TLS is tried for port 443 and `https` URLs. |  |

### net.proxy

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `required_no_proxy` | array of string | no |  | Entries that `NO_PROXY` must cover, such as `.svc` or `10.0.0.0/8`. | `[".svc", ".cluster.local"]` |
| `daemons_need_proxy` | boolean | no | `false` | The container runtime and kubelet must have the proxy too. The default is false. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: net.proxy
required_no_proxy:
- .svc
- .cluster.local
```

### net.tls_intercept

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hosts` | array of string | no |  | The hosts to test, 1 to 64. The default is every `net.egress` host in the spec. | `["registry.acme.test"]` |
| `expected_issuer` | string | no |  | A pattern the issuer of the chain must match. A chain from another issuer blocks. |  |
| `pin_sha256` | array of string | no |  | SHA-256 digests of certificates, 1 to 16, each 64 lowercase hex digits. |  |
| `forbid_interception` | boolean | no | `false` | A chain that only this machine trusts blocks instead of warning. The default is false. | `true` |

Example:

```yaml
id: net.tls_intercept
hosts:
- registry.acme.test
forbid_interception: true
```

### net.dns

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `names` | array of string or object | yes |  | The names to look up, 1 to 64. | `["registry.acme.test"]` |
| `max_latency` | string | no |  | A lookup slower than this: the check warns. The default, 500ms, is the check's. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: net.dns
names:
- registry.acme.test
```

#### names entries, as an object

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  | The name to look up. |  |
| `expect_in` | array of string | no |  | Every answer must be inside one of these ranges, 1 to 16. |  |
| `expect_public` | boolean | no |  | The answers must be public addresses (`true`) or private ones (`false`). |  |

### net.registry

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `registries` | array of string or object | yes |  | The registries, 1 to 16. Each one is a host, or an object with `host` and the options. Two entries with the same host are refused. | `[{"host": "registry.acme.test", "hosts": ["blobs.acme.test"], "images": ["acme/agent:1.4"]}]` |

Example:

```yaml
id: net.registry
registries:
- host: registry.acme.test
  hosts:
  - blobs.acme.test
  images:
  - acme/agent:1.4
```

#### registries entries, as an object

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | string | yes |  | The registry host, with a port when it is not 443. |  |
| `hosts` | array of string | no |  | The other hosts the registry uses: the token service and the blob store. At most 8, none twice. A host the check finds that is not listed is not contacted, and the result names it. |  |
| `images` | array of string | no |  | Public images to resolve to a manifest, 1 to 16, none twice. |  |
| `optional` | boolean | no | `false` | An unreachable registry warns and does not block. The default is false. |  |

### net.mtu

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_mtu` | integer | no |  | The pod network needs this MTU. An interface MTU, less the overlay header, below it blocks. | `1400` |
| `overlay` | one of `vxlan`, `geneve`, `wireguard`, `ipip` | no |  | The overlay the pod network will use. | `vxlan` |
| `underlay` | one of `ipv4`, `ipv6` | no | `ipv4` | The IP version under the overlay. The default is `ipv4`. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: net.mtu

overlay: vxlan
```

### net.bandwidth

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | yes |  | Where to download from. There is no default URL. | `https://mirror.acme.test/sample.bin` |
| `bytes` | integer or string | no |  | How much to download, 1Mi to 100Mi. The default is 10Mi. |  |
| `min_mbps` | number | no |  | A slower single stream blocks. In megabits per second, above 0 and at most 100000. | `50` |
| `recommended_mbps` | number | no |  | A slower single stream warns. In megabits per second, above 0 and at most 100000. |  |

Example:

```yaml

```

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | no |  | A class that must exist. The default is the cluster's default class. | `standard` |

| `binding` | one of `WaitForFirstConsumer`, `Immediate`, `any` | no | `any` | The binding mode the class must have. The default is `any`. |  |

### k8s.rbac

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `can` | array of string or object | yes |  | The permissions to test, 1 to 100. Each one is an entry in the audit log of the cluster. | `["create namespaces"]` |
| `namespace` | string | no |  | The namespace for the string items. The default is cluster scope. |  |

Example:

```yaml

```

#### can entries, as an object

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `verb` | string | yes |  | The verb. An RBAC verb such as `create`. `*` means all verbs. |  |
| `group` | string | no |  | The API group. Empty, which is the default, is the core group. |  |
| `resource` | string | yes |  | The resource. An RBAC resource such as `namespaces`. `*` means all resources. |  |
| `subresource` | string | no |  | The subresource, such as `log`. |  |
| `namespace` | string | no |  | The namespace of the object. For a string item this is the `namespace` of the entry. |  |
| `name` | string | no |  | The name of the object. Leave it out to mean all names. |  |

### k8s.admission

Dry-run checks are not supported yet.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pod_security` | one of `privileged`, `baseline`, `restricted` | no |  | The Pod Security level the product's pods need. | `baseline` |
| `namespace` | string | no |  | The namespace the product installs into. | `acme` |
| `scc` | string | no |  | The OpenShift security context constraint the product documents. |  |
| `uses` | array of one of `hostPath`, `hostNetwork`, `hostPID`, `privileged`, `runAsRoot` | no |  | Pod features the product needs. The check derives the lowest level from them. |  |

Example:

### k8s.nodes

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_ready` | integer | no |  | Fewer ready nodes than this: the check fails. | `3` |
| `min_zones` | integer | no |  | Fewer zones than this: the check fails. Without zone labels it is not evaluated. |  |
| `per_node` | object | no |  | Each counted node must have at least this much allocatable. These are allocatable amounts, not the size of the instance. | `{"cpu": 7, "memory": "28Gi"}` |
| `free` | object, see [per_node](#per_node) | no |  | The counted nodes together must have at least this much left after the pods' requests. |  |
| `arch` | array of one of `amd64`, `arm64`, `x86_64`, `aarch64` | no |  | The architectures the counted nodes may have, 1 to 4. `amd64` is `x86_64`. |  |
| `selector` | object | no |  | Only nodes with these labels are counted. |  |
| `tolerations` | array of object | no |  | Tolerations that make tainted nodes count, at most 16. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: k8s.nodes
min_ready: 3
per_node:
  cpu: 7
  memory: 28Gi
```

#### per_node

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cpu` | number or string | no |  | Cores as a number from 0.001 to 1000000 with at most three decimals, or a string of whole cores ("4") or millicores ("500m"), up to 1000000 cores. |  |
| `memory` | integer or string | no |  | Memory. |  |
| `pods` | integer | no |  | Pod slots. |  |
| `ephemeral` | integer or string | no |  | Ephemeral storage. |  |

#### tolerations entries

Without a key the operator must be Exists. With Exists there is no value.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | string | no |  | The taint key. Without it the operator is `Exists` and every taint matches. |  |
| `operator` | one of `Equal`, `Exists` | no |  | How the value is compared. Kubernetes treats a missing operator as `Equal`. |  |
| `value` | string | no |  | The taint value. Not with `Exists`. |  |
| `effect` | one of `NoSchedule`, `PreferNoSchedule`, `NoExecute` | no |  | The effect to tolerate. Without it every effect matches. |  |

### k8s.version

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | string or integer | no |  | An older server blocks. | `"1.28"` |
| `max` | string or integer | no |  | A newer server warns, or blocks with `over_max: block`. |  |
| `apis` | array of string | no |  | APIs the server must serve, 1 to 64. Each one is written `group/version Kind`, or `version Kind` for the core group. |  |
| `openshift_min` | string or integer | no |  | The lowest OpenShift version, used when the cluster is OpenShift. |  |
| `over_max` | one of `warn`, `block` | no | `warn` | What a server newer than `max` counts as. The default is `warn`. |  |

Example:

```yaml
id: k8s.version
min: "1.28"
```

### k8s.namespace

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | string | no |  | The namespace the product installs into. | `acme-system` |
| `quota_needs` | object | no |  | What the product needs from the quota of the namespace, by quota resource, 1 to 32. A quota with less left blocks. An amount of memory, storage, ephemeral storage or huge pages is a size in bytes with an optional binary suffix such as 64Gi (64G and 500m are refused). Other resources keep the Kubernetes form, such as 500m of requests.cpu. | `{"requests.cpu": 16, "requests.memory": "64Gi", "pods": 100}` |
| `limit_needs` | object | no |  | What the product needs from the limit range of the namespace. | `{"container_max_memory": "16Gi"}` |

Example:

```yaml
id: k8s.namespace
namespace: acme-system
quota_needs:
  requests.cpu: 16
  requests.memory: 64Gi
  pods: 100
limit_needs:
  container_max_memory: 16Gi
```

#### limit_needs

What the product needs from the limit range of the namespace.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `container_max_memory` | integer or string | no |  | The memory of the largest container the product runs. A limit range maximum below it blocks. |  |

### k8s.dns

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cluster_domain` | string | no |  | The cluster domain. The default is `cluster.local`. | `cluster.local` |

Example:

```yaml
id: k8s.dns
cluster_domain: cluster.local
```

### k8s.ingress

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | string | no |  | The controller of an IngressClass that must exist, such as `k8s.io/ingress-nginx`, or `any` for any class. It is the controller of the class, not its name. | `any` |
| `gateway_api` | one of `required`, `optional` | no |  | Whether the Gateway API must be installed. `required` blocks when it is missing, except where the platform has its own ingress. |  |
| `route` | boolean | no | `false` | The product needs an OpenShift Route. The default is false. |  |
| `loadbalancer` | boolean | no | `false` | The product needs a LoadBalancer service, so one that stays pending warns. The default is false. | `true` |

Example:

```yaml
id: k8s.ingress
controller: any
loadbalancer: true
```

### k8s.crds

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crds` | array of object | no |  | Custom resource definitions that must be installed, 1 to 64. | `[{"name": "certificates.cert-manager.io", "versions": ["v1"]}]` |
| `operators` | array of object | no |  | Operators whose deployment must run, 1 to 16. | `[{"namespace": "cert-manager", "deployment": "cert-manager", "min_version": "1.13"}]` |

Example:

```yaml
id: k8s.crds
crds:
- name: certificates.cert-manager.io
  versions:
  - v1
operators:
- namespace: cert-manager
  deployment: cert-manager
  min_version: "1.13"
```

#### crds entries

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  | The name of the definition, such as `certificates.cert-manager.io`. |  |
| `versions` | array of string | no |  | Versions the definition must serve, 1 to 16, none twice. Without it any version counts. |  |

#### operators entries

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | string | yes |  | The namespace of the deployment. |  |
| `deployment` | string | yes |  | The name of the deployment. |  |
| `min_version` | string or integer | no |  | An older operator blocks. It is read from the image tag or the version label of the deployment. |  |

### k8s.cni

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `network_policy` | one of `enforced` | no |  | What the network plugin must do with network policies. `enforced` blocks when it does not enforce them. | `enforced` |
| `needs_egress` | array of string | no |  | Destinations the product's pods need to reach, as host:port, 1 to 64, none twice. A default-deny policy in the namespace that does not allow them warns. Nothing is connected to. |  |
| `avoid_cidrs` | array of string | no |  | Address ranges that the pod and service networks must not overlap, 1 to 32, none twice. | `["10.0.0.0/8"]` |

Example:

```yaml
id: k8s.cni
network_policy: enforced
avoid_cidrs:
- 10.0.0.0/8
```

## bundle

The `bundle` block: what `rdy bundle` collects and how it redacts.

It parses in v1 and nothing acts on it yet. `rdy run` never collects anything, whatever this says. Unknown keys are refused.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collect` | array of string | no |  | Collectors: `journal:<duration>`, `k8s:events`, `file:<absolute path or glob>`. At most 64. |  |
| `redact` | array of string | no |  | Redactor groups to add, such as `aws_keys`, `bearer_tokens` or `emails`. At most 64. The built-in rules always run, so a spec can add redaction and can never remove it. |  |
| `redact_patterns` | array of object | no |  | Your own patterns, at most 32. A match is replaced with a `custom.<name>` placeholder. A pattern can only add redaction: where it overlaps a built-in match, the whole overlapping region is redacted. A pattern that matches the empty string is an error. |  |
| `max_size` | integer or string | no |  | Bundle size cap, such as `200Mi`. It lowers rdy's own cap and never raises it. |  |

### redact_patterns entries

A vendor redaction pattern in the `bundle` block.

| Property | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  | The rule name. A match is replaced with a `custom.<name>` placeholder. |  |
| `regex` | string | yes |  | The pattern, in Rust `regex` syntax (linear time, no backreferences), 1 to 256 characters. Not compiled here. |  |
